t: You're on St John Street, a historic street in Clerkenwell, in the London Borough of Islington. Mary Robison lived here. Born in 1623 and living until 1707, she was a member of the Society of Friends, the Quakers, and the wife of John Elson. Her long life spans a turbulent century, and she is the person this record connects to the street. Beyond that, the material is sparse.
